implementation.claim: VoiceHub-owned PyTorch implementation; numerical parity is not claimed without checkpoint-level evidence.
implementation.executable_checkpoint_compatibility: Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512 only; CosyVoice 1 and 2 use different graphs and are not claimed compatible.
implementation.legacy_policy: Published pickle-based .pt files and the ONNX-only speech tokenizer are accepted only by explicit audited conversion APIs. Normal loading and every exported artifact require Safetensors.
implementation.speech_tokenizer: Native encoder plus eight-dimensional ternary FSQ. The immutable ONNX file is parsed only by the one-time converter and is never executed at runtime.
